article.headline: Sacramento faces San Antonio on 3-game slide
article.description: Sacramento Kings (0-3, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (1-2, ninth in the Western Conference)
article.title: Sacramento faces San Antonio on 3-game slide
article.linkText: Sacramento faces San Antonio on 3-game slide
article.story: Sacramento Kings (0-3, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (1-2, ninth in the Western Conference) San Antonio; Tuesday, 8 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Sacramento heads into the matchup against San Antonio after losing three straight games. San Antonio finished 62-20 overall and 36-16 in Western Conference action a season ago. The Spurs shot 48.3% from the field and 35.9% from 3-point range last season. Sacramento went 22-60 overall and 14-38 in Western Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Kings shot 46.7% from the field and 34.0% from 3-point range last season. INJURIES: Spurs: Jayden Quaintance: out (knee), Tobias Harris: day to day (calf). Kings: Ben Simmons: out for season (achilles), Keegan Murray: out (ankle), Dylan Cardwell: out (calf), Maxime Raynaud: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
